items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Cause I played with his band I played tenor banjo with him for a good while

ctx.x: Somebody told me one time they played more blues uptown than they did down Only one band
Only one band Only one that used to play the most that played the blues was Chris Kelly Chris Kelly
I'll ask a couple questions, see like where you were born right here in New Orleans.

I started the playing in 1904 at Hugh Cloth's Dance Hall with O'Neill Lavish's Band, Franklin Y. Iberville. 1905 at Tom Anderson with Moran's Band, Basin and Iberville. 1907 at Harry Parker's Dance Hall, Dawson and Minetta's Band, Franklin between Iberville and Benwood. 1910 at Biller Phillips Dance Hall, Cornelius Jackson's Band, Franklin near Iberville. 1912 Liberty near Iberville, Huntson Nagel's Dance Hall with Joe Oliver's Band. 1915 with Chris Kelly's Band. 1918 Kid René's Band. 1921 Pippa Light Charles Band.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: And they had, uh, uh, Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly's band.

ctx.x: Because it was in the church, yeah. Yeah. And who would play in there?

Well, different bands, you know, like, I played with Rene there, kid Rene played there. We played there many times there, St. Catharines Hall. I remember now. And, uh, I believe, uh, I don't know where Buddy played, uh, but I know they had different bands that used to play there. Whose Buddy? It's been so long, Buddy Petit, you know. Oh, yeah. They had so many different bands. At that time, they had Kid, uh, Howard, and they had, uh, uh, Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly's band. And they had, uh, the, uh, Pelican band…
Mm-hmm. What, that, St. Catherine Hall, did they have, uh, dances there every night or just on the weekend?
